text.en:
Upon reaching Critical Health if your Class Ability is charged, or upon casting Barricade:
Spawns a Sunspot under you.

Only works with Sunbreaker Subclass.
The spawned Sunspot grants its benefits even without the Sol Invictus Aspect equipped.
text.ko:
방벽을 시전하거나 방벽이 충전된 상태에서 치명상을 입으면 방벽 소모와 함께 흑점이 생성됩니다.

생성된 흑점은 회복 x1을 부여합니다.
text.zh-chs: 太阳黑子提供“恢复 x1”效果。

text.zh-chs:
当职业技能充能完毕时受到重伤，或释放屏障时：
在你脚下生成一个太阳黑子。

仅在烈焰分支生效。
生成的太阳黑子即使没有装备“无敌索尔”星象也会获得其收益。

Only works with a <solar/>Solar Subclass.
The spawned Sunspot grants the Sol Invictus buff even without having the Aspect equipped.

text.en:
Only works with a <solar/>Solar Subclass.

Spawns a <solar/>Sunspot under you upon reaching Critical Health (if your Class Ability is charged as it consumes a Class Ability Charge) or upon casting a Barricade.

The spawned <solar/>Sunspot grants the Sol Invictus buff even without having the Aspect equipped. (The Aspect is still required to extend the sunspot's duration)

text.en:
Only works with a <solar/>Solar Super Ability equipped.

Reaching Critical Health consumes your Class Ability to spawn a <solar/>Sunspot under you.

Manually casting your Class Ability also spawns a <solar/>Sunspot under you.

The spawned <solar/>Sunspot grants the Sol Invictus buff even without having the Aspect equipped. (The Aspect is still required to extend the sunspot's duration)
